'''TA-1313''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] under [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the early stages of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], TA-1313 intercepted a coded [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] communication, the unscrambling of which revealed that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had enlisted [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] to travel to [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. Organa was to negotiate with King [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] to allow the use of the planet for transfer of supplies to the subjugated people of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

He proceeded to inform [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who in turn had the tactical droid contact [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to solve the matter on behalf of the Confederacy.

==Behind the scenes==
TA-1313 was originally believed to be [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]] in [[Supply Lines]], as the name was listed in the end credits. However, in late [[2012]], the online game, [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released an expansion of their card game, "Card Assault," which contained a card with an image of this droid, named TA-1313. Indeed the two tactical droids do look as if they were intended to be separate characters. In fact, TA-1313 bears a stronger resemblance to the [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Kiros)/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] on Kiros seen in [[Kidnapped]] than to TX-20, though it hasn't been confirmed if they are one and the same.
